name: Song Of The Sea
overview: The Song of the Sea, found in Exodus 15 and echoed in Revelation 15, celebrates God's triumphant deliverance of His people, vividly portraying His power in casting the horse and rider into the sea. This song, first sung by Moses and the Israelites and later affirmed by Miriam, magnifies the Lord's glorious victory and justice. In Revelation, the song is expanded to honor both Moses and the Lamb, highlighting God's marvelous works and His righteous reign as King of saints, pointing believers to Christ as the ultimate fulfillment of God's salvation.
